meta.title: Store map
meta.description: Find stores on the map: Konzum, Lidl, Kaufland, Spar, Plodine, Tommy, Studenac and 20 more chains across Croatia. Search by town or address and find the nearest one.

load.error: Stores can't be loaded right now.

unavailable.browser: Your browser can't show the map. Every store is still in the list.
unavailable.style: The map can't be loaded right now. Every store is still in the list.
unavailable.noGpu: Your browser has turned off graphics acceleration, so it can't show the map. Restarting the browser usually fixes it. Every store is still in the list.

nearMe.denied: Location access is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings or search by town.
nearMe.unavailable: Your location isn't available right now. Search by town or address.
nearMe.timeout: Finding your location is taking too long. Try again or search by town.

count.unplaced: {shown}, {unplaced} of them without a location on the map. They're still in the list.

list.onMapStatus: {count, plural, one {# store} other {# stores}} on the map
list.sameSpot: {count, plural, one {# store} other {# stores}} at this spot

details.notPlaced: We don't have an exact location for this store yet, so it isn't on the map.
